title: Current ED209 controller and field acceptance boundary
summary: RexxOS RTO2 Grid dev14 proves the generic first-class MU/MI controller substrate at an 8-MU/16-MI minimum; ED209 is the distinct ten-MU/twenty-MI field estate and still lacks a confirmed live 20/20 authenticated committed run.
invariants: Do not report the generic dev14 8-MU/16-MI minimum reference estate as the complete ED209 field topology.
F and H extend the earlier eight-MU field estate to ten MUs and twenty MIs; append identities rather than renumbering established routes.
Candidate2 and local controller tests are development evidence, not a live ten-host acceptance receipt.
An XTP transport ACK, a QEMU process, a controller object, or an economic recommendation does not establish executed and committed work.
